name: 92887 · Yorba Linda, CA
findings: ZIP 92887 (Yorba Linda) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 26 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92887 (Yorba Linda) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
46% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
